{{Quote|The Neo-Crusaders smashed a Republic task force at Commenor and ravaged Duro in 3962 BBY&mdash;but that was as far as they would get.|From [[Vilnau Teupt]]'s "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]," [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
The [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] were in the midst of a war with the Republic that had been fought between them for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. In [[3962 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] decided to push from their [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to capture the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. They launched a two-pronged attack, which they dubbed '''Mandalorian Triumph''', from their holdings, one of which was [[Battle of the Randon system (Mandalorian Wars)|halted]] by a Republic victory at the [[Randon system/Legends|Randon system]], and another that successfully raided a large number of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] before succeeding in [[Battle of Duro (Mandalorian Wars)|taking Duro]].
